stops.source: oscnb stopcontact: first contact at half the shunt's rise from its free level (the 5 ms box's median over 40 ms after the 0.1 s spin-up) to its seated one (over the rung's last 100 ms less 5 ms), at least min rise counts; the rung's ripple seeded within 30 % of the line its free stretch's pot speed predicts at the fast rungs' table's counts a cycle; placed in the fit's frame by its samples up to g_cycles before contact; a stop the median of its rungs whose track holds within check_share of the table's counts a cycle; contact_raw through the table, pin_raw moved outward to the 16-count grid, contact_counts in the table's counts; travel contact to contact x 360 over brushes x rotor_segments x gear_ratio

table.seed: fast rungs at the middle of the rung; slow rungs on the tallest line within 30 % of the pot's speed over its first 4000 rows tracked over the fast rungs' table's local counts a cycle; a slow rung at [(1.8, 2.2), (0.45, 0.55)] of a fast rung's cycles set aside

gear_play.why: the plan takes the play from the mean difference of the pass offsets; these offsets hold each rung's own start of counting, so they cannot carry it

source.pot: pot counts a ripple cycle on each slow rung the table read, read again over its whole drive on the line the table read was seeded on; r the counts over the pass's median over its inner cycles; a hole where r > 1 + far_k s, s the noise_percentile of |r - 1| over those inner cycles; flagged cycles merge_gap_cycles apart on a rung, and holes from any rungs within touch_counts, are one; degrees from the low pin through the run's table over its counts_per_deg, shaft_deg the cycles x 360 over the nameplate's brushes x rotor_segments x gear_ratio
source.adc: the ADC's wide codes: runs of codes the slow passes' driven rows never read, each wholly inside the codes a slow rung crossed less the edge margin at each turn (oscnb widecodes.find's rule); degrees over the table's counts_per_deg
